name: Factorial numbers: n! = 1*2*3*4*...*n (order of symmetric group S_n, number of permutations of n letters).
formula: Exp(x) = Sum_{m >= 0} x^m/m!. - _Mohammad K. Azarian_, Dec 28 2010
Sum_{i=0..n} (-1)^i * i^n * binomial(n, i) = (-1)^n * n!. - Yong Kong (ykong(AT)curagen.com), Dec 26 2000
Sum_{i=0..n} (-1)^i * (n-i)^n * binomial(n, i) = n!. - Peter C. Heinig (algorithms(AT)gmx.de), Apr 10 2007

name: The simplest sequence of positive numbers: the all 1's sequence.
formula: E.g.f.: exp(x).

name: Number of distinct primes dividing n (also called omega(n)).
formula: G.f.: Sum_{k>=1} x^prime(k)/(1-x^prime(k)). - _Benoit Cloitre_, Apr 21 2003; corrected by _Franklin T. Adams-Watters_, Sep 01 2009
Dirichlet generating function: zeta(s)*primezeta(s). - _Franklin T. Adams-Watters_, Sep 11 2005
Additive with a(p^e) = 1.

name: pi(n), the number of primes <= n. Sometimes called PrimePi(n) to distinguish it from the number 3.14159...
formula: The prime number theorem gives the asymptotic expression a(n) ~ n/log(n).
For x > 1, pi(x) < (x / log x) * (1 + 3/(2 log x)). For x >= 59, pi(x) > (x / log x) * (1 + 1/(2 log x)). [Rosser and Schoenfeld]

name: The positive integers. Also called the natural numbers, the whole numbers or the counting numbers, but these terms are ambiguous.
formula: Multiplicative with a(p^e) = p^e. - _David W. Wilson_, Aug 01 2001
Another g.f.: Sum_{n>0} phi(n)*x^n/(1-x^n) (Apostol).

name: Squarefree numbers: numbers that are not divisible by a square greater than 1.
formula: Limit_{n->oo} a(n)/n = Pi^2/6 (see A013661). - _Benoit Cloitre_, May 23 2002
Equals A039956 UNION A056911. - _R. J. Mathar_, May 16 2008
A122840(a(n)) <= 1; A010888(a(n)) < 9. - _Reinhard Zumkeller_, Mar 30 2010

name: Pascal's triangle read by rows: C(n,k) = binomial(n,k) = n!/(k!*(n-k)!), 0 <= k <= n.
formula: a(n, k) = C(n,k) = binomial(n, k).
The triangle is symmetric: C(n,k) = C(n,n-k).

name: Ones-counting sequence: number of 1's in binary expansion of n (or the binary weight of n).
formula: a(0) = 0, a(2^i) = 1; otherwise if n = 2^i + j with 0 < j < 2^i, a(n) = a(j) + 1.
G.f.: Product_{k >= 0} (1 + y*x^(2^k)) = Sum_{n >= 0} y^a(n)*x^n. - _N. J. A. Sloane_, Jun 04 2009

name: Primorial numbers (first definition): product of first n primes. Sometimes written prime(n)#.
formula: Asymptotic expression for a(n): exp((1 + o(1)) * n * log(n)) where o(1) is the "little o" notation. - Dan Fux (dan.fux(AT)OpenGaia.com or danfux(AT)OpenGaia.com), Apr 08 2001
Binomial transform = A136104: (1, 3, 11, 55, 375, 3731, ...). Equals binomial transform of A121572: (1, 1, 3, 17, 119, 1509, ...). - _Gary W. Adamson_, Dec 14 2007
